description: Android v1.69.1 touch controls, real InputEventScreenTouch/ScreenDrag events: the toolbar lives inside Main right after BoardRoot (under game overlays); Board rotates the view 90 degrees; while placing a deployment ghost a held finger only AIMS (nothing placed, no long-press) and the model drops where the finger lifts; dragging a placed model picks it up again (Shift+click on desktop) and drops it on lift; the toolbar collapses to its handle; Multi holds a sticky Ctrl; ? opens the touch cheat sheet and Back closes it.

steps.script:
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var g = dc.ghost_sprite
return dc.get_placed_count() == 0 and TouchInputAdapter.state == 6 and TouchInputAdapter.stats.long_presses == 0 and g != null and g.global_position.distance_to(TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('b')) < 4.0

var tp = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller.temp_positions
return tp.size() == 1 and tp[0] != null and tp[0].distance_to(Vector2(1300.0, 1700.0)) < 4.0 and TouchInputAdapter.stats.hover_places == 1

var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var tp = dc.temp_positions
return not dc.repositioning_model and tp.size() == 1 and tp[0].distance_to(Vector2(1420.0, 1820.0)) < 4.0

var tb = tree.current_scene.get_node('TouchToolbar')
return TouchInputAdapter.toolbar_collapsed and not tb.find_child('Touch_Fit', true, false).visible and tb.find_child('Touch_Collapse', true, false).is_visible_in_tree()
return not TouchInputAdapter.multi_mode and not Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_CTRL)
